seoTitle: Assign Tasks in Smartsheet and Notify Your Team
metaDescription: Delegate work in Smartsheet using Contact List columns, automated assignment notifications, and Card View lanes organized by owner.
intro: Ownership confusion kills momentum on any project. Smartsheet's Contact List columns make task assignment explicit, and pairing that with automated notifications means nobody misses being tagged on new work. This guide covers setting up assignment, notifications, and workload visibility.

steps.heading: Add a Contact List column
steps.body: Configure a Contact List column type to enable proper user tagging and resource tracking.

steps.heading: Assign owners to tasks
steps.body: Assign individual team members, multiple assignees, or external collaborators directly from sheet cells.

steps.heading: Use the Account Directory
steps.body: Search and select team members quickly by name or email address from the directory.

steps.heading: Automate assignment notifications
steps.body: Configure a workflow to instantly notify team members the moment a task is assigned to them.

steps.heading: Track workload by owner
steps.body: Set up a Card View lane layout organized by assignee, and use the Workload Tracking panel to monitor capacity and prevent burnout.

faq.question: Does Smartsheet notify people automatically when assigned a task?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure automated workflow recipes to notify team members the exact moment they're assigned.

faq.question: Can I assign a task to more than one person?
faq.answer: Yes, Contact List columns support assigning multiple assignees or external collaborators to a single task.

faq.question: How do I see who's overloaded on my team?
faq.answer: The Workload Tracking panel lets you monitor team capacity and spot potential burnout across projects.

faq.question: Can I view tasks grouped by assignee?
faq.answer: Yes, Card View can be customized into lanes organized dynamically by assigned owner.
